raw.description: 战斗阶段结束时，若对手处于烧伤状态则获得3回合的神惧劫炎，自身已处于神惧劫炎时改为令其回合数+1，若对手不处于烧伤状态则恢复自身最大体力的1/3并附加恢复量的百分比伤害，然后若此伤害未减少对手体力则自身额外获得最大体力1/3的护盾|对手使用攻击技能时令对手烧伤，未触发则消除对手回合类效果，然后若自身不处于烧伤则自身下1次进入的异常状态转化为2回合的烧伤|自身存活于出战背包时，对手免疫能力下降状态时视为处于烧伤状态|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 四项已答补齐当前敌免弱动态视烧伤、真实烧伤标准威力和扣血、神惧技能前扣与末回合收益、直接PP调整穿透保护；仅当前来源真实在场以外的背包光环覆盖需队伍。

success.name: 4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次
success.assertion: test('4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),compiled.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);if(m.id===10986){assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.ok(m.deferredEffects.some(x=>x.field==='atk_num'));assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4875 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4875真实2062无烧伤战阶回复最大HP三分一并附实际恢复量粉伤，零恢复/免伤/保1零HP损失才授盾，过量不降低自身恢复
success.assertion: test('4875真实2062无烧伤战阶回复最大HP三分一并附实际恢复量粉伤，零恢复/免伤/保1零HP损失才授盾，过量不降低自身恢复',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','full','immune','floor','overkill','skill-ban']){const s=make({move:20449,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:4000);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='full'||mode==='immune'?0:3000);const n=require('../dist/shield-rules.js').sourceValue(s.fighters[0],'4875:soul2062:822cba61:heal-failed-damage');assert.equal(n,['full','immune','floor'].includes(mode)?3000:0);if(mode==='floor'){const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,3000);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}});

success.name: 4875真实2062敌实际用攻时先烧伤并按真实威力影响其红伤，MISS/整招无效仍触发，控制/药剂/属性不触发
success.assertion: test('4875真实2062敌实际用攻时先烧伤并按真实威力影响其红伤，MISS/整招无效仍触发，控制/药剂/属性不触发',()=>{for(const mode of['hit','miss','invalid','control','potion','status']){const s=make({move:20449,soul:true});if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'攻击必失');}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,1,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s,20449,mode==='potion'?null:mode==='status'?20117:10127);const actual=['hit','miss','invalid'].includes(mode);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],actual);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.nextBurnConversion2062,actual);if(actual)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.remaining,2);}const a=make({move:20449,soul:true}),b=make({move:20449});turn(a,20449,10127);turn(b,20449,10127);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<sum(b,'attack',1));});

success.name: 4875真实2062烧伤未触发清敌回合，之后自己的下一次实际准入异常转2烧伤；免异失败不消费，已有烧伤不再准备
success.assertion: test('4875真实2062烧伤未触发清敌回合，之后自己的下一次实际准入异常转2烧伤；免异失败不消费，已有烧伤不再准备',()=>{for(const ownBurn of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20449,soul:true});if(ownBurn)s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.a.effects['攻击必中'],undefined);assert.equal(!!c.t.soulState.nextBurnConversion2062,!ownBurn);if(!ownBurn){assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,3,{probabilityPercent:100}),false);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.nextBurnConversion2062,true);assert.equal(c.ailment(c.t,'害怕',c.a,false,false,3,{probabilityPercent:100}),true);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['害怕'],undefined);assert.equal(c.t.ailments['烧伤'],2);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.nextBurnConversion2062,undefined);}checked=true;}},()=>turn(s,20449,10127));assert.equal(checked,true);}});

success.name: 4875真实神惧首次授3已有只加1且最高8，回合结束后按对应槽已损PP调整并自然扣1，PP目标不足归0不变队伍
success.assertion: test('4875真实神惧首次授3已有只加1且最高8，回合结束后按对应槽已损PP调整并自然扣1，PP目标不足归0不变队伍',()=>{const s=make({move:20449,soul:true});s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=5;s.fighters[0].moves.forEach((k,i)=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=Math.max(0,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-[2,1,3,0,1][i]));turn(s);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062;assert.equal(st.grants[0].remaining,3);assert.equal(st.remaining,2);assert.ok(st.ppAdjustments.length);for(const event of st.ppAdjustments){const k=s.fighters[1].moves[event.slot];assert.equal(s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-s.fighters[1].pp[k],Math.min(s.moveDefinitions[k].pp,event.ownLost));}const cap=make({move:20449,soul:true});cap.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062={remaining:8,sourceHash:'822cba61'};cap.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=5;cap.fighters[1].stats.spe=1000;turn(cap);assert.equal(cap.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.grants[0].remaining,8);assert.equal(cap.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.remaining,7);});

success.name: 4875真实神惧已知无分歧先手分支加2先制和翻倍红伤、额外扣1并延长已有烧伤，非先手不额外扣与延长
success.assertion: test('4875真实神惧已知无分歧先手分支加2先制和翻倍红伤、额外扣1并延长已有烧伤，非先手不额外扣与延长',()=>{for(const first of[false,true]){const a=make({move:10980,soul:true}),b=make({move:10980});a.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062={remaining:5,sourceHash:'822cba61'};for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;if(!first){s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].priority=6;s.fighters[1].stats.spe=1000;}}turn(a);turn(b);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],first?4:3);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.remaining,first?4:5);assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*2));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*2));}});

success.name: 4875已答四项：比例清除、免弱动态视烧伤、末回合收益及先手刷新时序、PP保护穿透均提交真实状态
success.assertion: test('4875已答四项：比例清除、免弱动态视烧伤、末回合收益及先手刷新时序、PP保护穿透均提交真实状态',()=>{for(const kind of['ratio','virtual','last','refresh','pp']){const s=make({move:kind==='ratio'?38284:kind==='refresh'?29275:20449,soul:true});if(kind==='ratio')s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=2;if(kind==='virtual')timer(s,1,'免弱');if(['last','refresh'].includes(kind))s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062={remaining:kind==='last'?1:5};if(kind==='pp'){s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=5;s.fighters[0].pp[key(20449)]=1;timer(s,1,'PP保护');}turn(s);assert.equal(s.round,2);if(kind==='ratio'){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'].fraction,.5);}if(kind==='virtual'){assert.equal(require('../dist/status-rules.js').active(s.fighters[1],'烧伤',1),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,7875);}if(kind==='last'){assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.remaining,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.firstMoves.length,1);}if(kind==='refresh')assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.firstMoves.length,1);if(kind==='pp')assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.ppAdjustments.length>0);}});

success.assertion: const other=require('../research/BATCH-4816-REMAINING/4872/snapshot.json'),o={move:20449,index:-1,enemySource:other,enemyLoadout:[10157,10629,20044,29270,38275],enemySoul:true},a=make({...o,soul:true}),b=make(o);a.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062={remaining:3};let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.t.ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(R.active(c.t,'烧伤',c.round),true);assert.equal(R.powerMultiplier(c.t,c.round),.5);c.t.soulState.lotus2059.form='pale';assert.equal(R.active(c.t,'烧伤',c.round),false);c.t.soulState.lotus2059.form='mesh';const hp=c.a.hp;c.a.hp=0;assert.equal(R.active(c.t,'烧伤',c.round),false);c.a.hp=hp;checked=true;}},()=>turn(a,20449,10157));turn(b,20449,10157);assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(E.describeEffects(a.fighters[1],a.round).some(t=>t.includes('免弱期间视为烧伤')));const real=make({...o,soul:true});real.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(real,20449,10157);assert.equal(real.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='percent'&&e.targetSide===1).length,1);assert.equal(real.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='percent'&&e.targetSide===1).settledDamage,1125);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)<sum(b,'attack',1)*.65);const ticks=a.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='percent'&&e.targetSide===1&&e.sourceSide===0);assert.equal(ticks.length,1);assert.equal(ticks[0].settledDamage,1125);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.firstMoves[0].afterBurn,undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.grants.length>0);

success.assertion: test('4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),compiled.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);if(m.id===10986){assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.ok(m.deferredEffects.some(x=>x.field==='atk_num'));assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4875 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.assertion: test('4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),compiled.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);if(m.id===10986){assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.ok(m.deferredEffects.some(x=>x.field==='atk_num'));assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4875 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4875/2240伤前净自身异常成功本招威力翻倍，烧伤先清不再减半；2418整招无效获得敌最大HP三分一双盾，零红命中不补偿
success.assertion: test('4875/2240伤前净自身异常成功本招威力翻倍，烧伤先清不再减半；2418整招无效获得敌最大HP三分一双盾，零红命中不补偿',()=>{for(const status of[null,'烧伤','中毒']){const a=make(row(2240)),b=make({...row(2240),index:-1});if(status)a.fighters[0].ailments[status]=3;const power=powerProbe(()=>turn(a));turn(b);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments[status],undefined);assert.equal(power,status?170:85);if(status){assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);assert.ok(sum(a)<=sum(b)*2+1);}else assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));}for(const mode of['invalid','zero','control']){const s=make(row(2418));if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(s);const S=require('../dist/shield-rules.js'),src='4875:38282:6a2b8009:2418';assert.equal(S.sourceValue(s.fighters[0],src),mode==='invalid'?3000:0);assert.equal(S.barrierSourceValue(s.fighters[0],src),mode==='invalid'?3000:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4875/1676当前及三回合每次真实用招沸涌，免异失败才全强化；1014半体以上全二否则全一；843下两回合先制2',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1676));if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['沸涌'],!immune);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],immune?1:0);}for(const hp of[4500,4501]){const s=make({...row(1014),hp});turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],hp===4501?2:1);}const p=make({...row(843),loadout:[29276,10980,29275,38282,38284]});turn(p);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(p,10980);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}});

success.name: 4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次
success.assertion: test('4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),compiled.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);if(m.id===10986){assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.ok(m.deferredEffects.some(x=>x.field==='atk_num'));assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4875 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4875/1674理论最大HP三分一百分比吸取，免粉仍恢复3000且补280真，2198/2199任一方各自盾罩条件独立烧伤焚烬
success.assertion: test('4875/1674理论最大HP三分一百分比吸取，免粉仍恢复3000且补280真，2198/2199任一方各自盾罩条件独立烧伤焚烬',()=>{for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(1674),hp:1000});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:3000);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),immune?280:0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4000);}for(const[id,status,kind]of[[2198,'烧伤','shield'],[2199,'焚烬','barrier']])for(const side of[null,0,1]){const s=make(row(id));if(side!==null)require('../dist/shield-rules.js')[kind==='shield'?'refresh':'refreshBarrier'](s.fighters[side],1000,'fixture');turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments[status],side!==null);}});

success.name: 4875/1676三回合真实用招每次沸涌到期后不触发，1674四回合吸取到期且血药不触发
success.assertion: test('4875/1676三回合真实用招每次沸涌到期后不触发，1674四回合吸取到期且血药不触发',()=>{const a=make({...row(1676),loadout:[29275,10980,29276,38282,38284]});for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){delete a.fighters[1].ailments['沸涌'];turn(a,r===1?29275:10980);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['沸涌'],r<=3);}const b=make({...row(1674),loadout:[29276,10980,29275,38282,38284],targetHp:9000});for(let r=1;r<=5;r++){b.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(b,r===1?29276:r===2?null:10980);assert.equal(sum(b,'percent'),r<=4&&r!==2?3000:0);}});

success.assertion: test('4875全部21招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2062原生用招，野火燎原原3目标仅当前目标攻击一次',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),compiled.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);if(m.id===10986){assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.ok(m.deferredEffects.some(x=>x.field==='atk_num'));assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length,1);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4875 base '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.name: 4875/1268真实击败请求接续当前敌已复活的下回合前态，仅限定三种各独立2或3回合，无放回且免异失败不补抽
success.assertion: test('4875/1268真实击败请求接续当前敌已复活的下回合前态，仅限定三种各独立2或3回合，无放回且免异失败不补抽',()=>{const durations=new Map(['烧伤','冻伤','中毒'].map(k=>[k,new Set()]));for(const immune of[0,1])for(let seed=1;seed<=20;seed++){const s=make({...row(1268),targetHp:1,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750);/* Explicit fixture: same current target has returned alive before next round; no claim to implement its revival. */s.finished=false;s.winner=null;s.fighters[1].hp=9000;s.fighters[1].counts.immune=immune;s.fighters[1].soulState.deathResolved=false;turn(s,38282);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750,undefined);const ailments=s.fighters[1].ailments;assert.equal(Object.keys(ailments).length,3-immune);for(const[k,end]of Object.entries(ailments)){assert.ok(durations.has(k));const n=end-2+1;assert.ok([2,3].includes(n));durations.get(k).add(n);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.immune,0);}for(const set of durations.values())assert.deepEqual(set,new Set([2,3]));});

success.name: 4875/1268受控真实重放组件按组件源hash与实际使用序号记录击败，不误绑实际根技能，也不重复扣组件PP
success.assertion: test('4875/1268受控真实重放组件按组件源hash与实际使用序号记录击败，不误绑实际根技能，也不重复扣组件PP',()=>{const s=make({move:38282,index:-1,targetHp:200}),engine=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let injected=false;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...engine,run(phase,ops,c){const out=engine.run(phase,ops,c);if(!injected&&phase==='afterHit'&&c.a.side===0&&c.m.wikiId===38282){injected=true;c.reproduceSkillComponent(structuredClone(s.moveDefinitions[key(38283)]));}return out;}};try{turn(s);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=engine;}assert.equal(injected,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.replaySkillUses[key(38283)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(38283)],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38283)],source.moves.find(m=>m.id===38283).pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750.sourceMove,38283);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.delayedAilments4750.count,3);});

success.name: 4875/1959先清敌回合且烧伤成功不翻倍，清回合失败或免异导致烧伤失败翻倍；572真实烧伤才焚烬与1820低100补200真
success.assertion: test('4875/1959先清敌回合且烧伤成功不翻倍，清回合失败或免异导致烧伤失败翻倍；572真实烧伤才焚烬与1820低100补200真',()=>{for(const mode of['success','none','immune']){const a=make(row(1959)),b=make(row(1959));for(const s of[a,b]){if(mode==='none')s.fighters[1].effects={};if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;}turn(a);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)c.a.soulState.clearBurn1959.doubled=false;},()=>turn(b));assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],mode==='success');if(mode==='success')assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));else{assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*2));assert.ok(sum(a)<Math.ceil((sum(b)+1)*2));}}for(const burn of[false,true]){const s=make(row(572));if(burn)s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],burn);}const z=make(row(1820));timer(z,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(z);assert.equal(sum(z,'true'),200);});

success.name: 4875/2419双方仅烧伤按剩余回合总和清除并授神惧，上限8、已有加等量；非烧伤按已答比例限制回复
success.assertion: test('4875/2419双方仅烧伤按剩余回合总和清除并授神惧，上限8、已有加等量；非烧伤按已答比例限制回复',()=>{for(const existing of[0,4]){const s=make(row(2419));s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=2;s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;if(existing)s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062={remaining:existing,sourceHash:'822cba61'};turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.remaining,Math.min(8,existing+5));}const q=make(row(2419));q.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;turn(q);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].ailments['中毒'],undefined);assert.equal(q.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'].fraction,1);});

success.assertion: for(const [own,enemy,fraction,rounds]of[[['烧伤'],['烧伤'],0,5],[['中毒'],['中毒'],1,0],[['烧伤','中毒'],['中毒'],.5,2],[['烧伤','中毒'],['冻伤'],2/3,2],[[],[],0,0]]){const s=make({move:38284,index:1,targetHp:4000});for(const n of own)s.fighters[0].ailments[n]=2;for(const n of enemy)s.fighters[1].ailments[n]=3;let healed;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)healed=c.heal(c.a,900,'验证回复比例','soul');},()=>turn(s));const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.purge2419Events[0];assert.equal(event.fraction,fraction);assert.equal(event.burnRounds,rounds);assert.equal(healed,Math.floor(900*(1-fraction)));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].ailments,{});if(rounds)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.inferno2062.grants[0].requested,rounds);if(fraction>0){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['回复效果削减'].end,2);s.moveDefinitions[key(38284)].operations=[];for(let r=2;r<=3;r++){s.fighters[1].hp=1000;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)healed=c.heal(c.a,900,'到期回复','skill');},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(healed,r===2?Math.floor(900*(1-fraction)):900);}}}

instance.description: 造成的攻击伤害若低于100则附加给对手200点真实伤害

raw.description: 消除对手回合类效果，消除成功100%令对手烧伤，未触发则造成的攻击伤害翻倍；解除双方所处的异常状态，触发成功对手2回合内体力恢复效果减少其中烧伤以外异常状态个数的比例，且为自身附加回合数等于其中烧伤回合数合计的神惧劫炎，自身已处于神惧劫炎时改为令其增加等量的回合数；攻击对手时若对手处于烧伤状态，则100%使对手焚烬；造成的攻击伤害若低于100则附加给对手200点真实伤害
